create_meshes_batch: create a Meshes object from a list of vertex and face tensors for batched 3D mesh processing
get_verts_packed: get the packed vertex tensor of shape (sum(V_n), 3) from a Meshes object
offset_mesh_vertices: offset the vertices of a Meshes object in place by a given 3D displacement tensor
join_meshes_as_batch: join multiple Meshes objects into a single batched Meshes object with optional texture merging
join_meshes_as_scene: join a batch of meshes into a single unified mesh with combined textures
